evidence.reason: I1 (contract item 2) requires JSON on stdout and, in --json mode, empty stderr. The shared JsonArgumentParser overrides only error(); argparse's default help action still prints plain-text help to stdout and exits 0 for `--json deploy --help` before main dispatches. Machine mode therefore emits non-JSON stdout, an implementation gap in the existing output contract rather than a new requirement.
